title: calochortus montanus
intro: Calochortus montanus, commonly known as the golden star or mountain mariposa lily, is a perennial plant species native to the mountainous regions of the western United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Calochortus montanus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of infections, wounds, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory activities.
